event_title: Gojek and Tokopedia combine to form GoTo
description: Gojek and Tokopedia announced/completed combination into GoTo group creating a multi-service Indonesian tech group including e-commerce.
source: Reuters / company contemporaneous reporting (secondary summary used with caution)
notes: Ownership/structure change; not labeled as causal for market share.

event_title: GoTo lists on Indonesia Stock Exchange
description: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk completed IDX listing (stock code GOTO).

event_title: Ministry of Trade Regulation No. 31 of 2023 on e-commerce/social commerce
description: Regulation effective 26 Sep 2023 restricting social-commerce payment facilitation and related e-commerce operator obligations.
source: Allen & Gledhill legal explainer summarizing Mot Reg 31/2023
notes: Capture official regulation text in later enrichment if needed; event is contextual not causal proof.

event_title: TikTok pauses Shop retail transactions in Indonesia
description: TikTok official newsroom: will no longer facilitate e-commerce transactions in TikTok Shop Indonesia effective 4 Oct 2023 17:00 WIB.
notes: Corroborated by Kompas and AP reporting.

event_title: GoTo and TikTok announce strategic e-commerce partnership
description: Official announcement that Tokopedia and TikTok Shop Indonesia businesses will be combined under PT Tokopedia with TikTok taking controlling stake; TikTok commits >US$1.5bn over time; shopping features in TikTok app to be operated by enlarged Tokopedia entity; pilot under regulator consultation.
source: TikTok Newsroom (also mirrored in GoTo/CNN coverage)

event_title: GoTo and TikTok complete Tokopedia transaction
description: GoTo announced completion of transaction with TikTok; Tokopedia and TikTok Shop Indonesia businesses combined under PT Tokopedia with TikTok holding controlling stake; GoTo retains minority stake and receives e-commerce service fee arrangement.
notes: Creates disclosure break for Tokopedia metrics in GoTo filings; do not treat as proven cause of Shopee share changes.

event_title: Reuters reports TikTok completes control of Tokopedia enabling Shop restart path
description: Reuters reported completion of TikTok deal for controlling stake in Tokopedia and context of restarting online shopping business under the enlarged entity.
notes: Corroborates EVT005; retained as separate citation for provenance.

event_title: Tokopedia & TikTok Shop Seller Center soft launch (early April 2025)
description: TikTok newsroom (11 Jun 2025) states Seller Center soft launch in early April 2025 before official launch; sellers reported operational benefits during migration.
notes: Exact calendar day in early April not specified in source; month-level event marker.

event_title: Tokopedia & TikTok Shop Seller Center officially launched
description: Official launch of integrated Seller Center allowing sellers to manage Tokopedia and/or TikTok Shop from one dashboard; affiliate and live shopping access highlighted; sellers may choose Tokopedia only TTS only or both.
notes: Company-stated seller GMV uplift stats are self-reported samples — treat as CONTEXT not national GMV.

event_title: KPPU fines TikTok Nusantara for late Tokopedia acquisition notification
description: KPPU Decision 02/KPPU-M/2025: Rp15 billion fine for late/improper post-closing notification of Tokopedia acquisition effective 31 Jan 2024; confirms ownership 75.01% TikTok / 24.99% GoTo.
notes: Administrative notification case; not itself a market-share observation.
